svg.title: lance-csr architecture
svg.desc: A Cypher frontend builds a graph plan, which is lowered into a DataFusion plan. At each DataFusion stage, lance-csr adds graph-specific pieces alongside the built-ins. Execution reads Lance datasets, and in-memory CSR and node indexes that point back to Lance by row address. Components added in lance-csr are highlighted.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: each hop becomes a CSR operator
or a pair of hash joins
